universities.name: Shandong University Cheeloo College of Medicine
universities.summary: Shandong University Cheeloo College of Medicine offers a six-year English-medium Clinical Medicine (MBBS) programme for international students. Its 2026 admission page lists RMB 45,000 annual tuition, a 31 July application deadline and 1 September registration. WDOMS lists the school as currently operational and records that one or more programmes meet the Intealth Recognized Accreditation Policy.
universities.campusLifestyle: The English MBBS programme is delivered through Shandong University’s medical education structure in Jinan. The current admissions information lists accommodation separately from tuition, so a residence place, room type and personal living budget are not included in the programme fee.
universities.cityProfile: Jinan is the programme city named in Shandong University’s international bachelor listing. The published tuition, accommodation, insurance and registration charges are separate items; this package does not turn them into an all-inclusive cost estimate.
universities.practicalExposure: The MBBS course is a six-year Clinical Medicine programme. WDOMS records clinical training for the medical school. The reviewed sources do not allocate a named hospital or specialty placement to an individual incoming applicant, so no specific rotation site is promised.
universities.hostelOverview: The 2026 MBBS admission page lists accommodation at RMB 8,000–12,000 per year. Availability and room allocation are administered separately from academic admission.
universities.dietarySupport: The sources reviewed do not publish an MBBS meal plan or dietary benefit. Food and personal expenses are separate from tuition, accommodation and compulsory insurance.
universities.safetyOverview: The reviewed programme sources provide international-admissions and registration contacts but do not publish Medicine-specific safety statistics. This package does not make a safety guarantee.
universities.studentSupport: The MBBS admissions page provides separate academic and international-admission contacts. It also publishes accommodation and insurance requirements for incoming students; service availability and costs remain subject to the university’s current terms.

faq.question: How long is Shandong University MBBS?
faq.answer: The 2026 English-medium Clinical Medicine listing states a six-year programme.

faq.question: What is the 2026 MBBS tuition?
faq.answer: The official 2026 MBBS page lists tuition of RMB 45,000 per year. Accommodation, insurance and other listed charges are separate.

faq.question: When is the 2026 application deadline?
faq.answer: The September 2026 batch lists 31 July 2026 as the application deadline and 1 September 2026 as registration.

faq.question: Is the programme taught in English?
faq.answer: Yes. Shandong University’s 2026 MBBS admission page identifies Clinical Medicine (MBBS) as an English-medium programme.

faq.question: What happens after admission?
faq.answer: Students who complete the stated payment process receive the final admission letter and JW202 form for the study-visa process.

faq.question: Is the medical school listed internationally?
faq.answer: WDOMS lists Shandong University Cheeloo College of Medicine as currently operational and records recognized-accreditation-policy eligibility for one or more programmes.
